categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Jingxue Insulation Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the research, design, production, and sales of energy-saving insulation materials for cold storage and industrial building envelope systems. Its main products include metal-faced energy-saving insulation sandwich panels and supporting products such as cold storage doors, industrial doors, and lifting platforms. The company serves cold chain logistics and industrial building sectors, providing integrated envelope system solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced continuous and non-continuous polyurethane foam production lines, including proprietary formulations and process controls for PUR/PIR rigid foam panels with thicknesses up to 250mm. It has developed patented technologies such as maze-type groove interlocking for panels to reduce thermal loss and high flame-retardant PIR panel production techniques. Intelligent manufacturing is implemented with automated production lines, robotic welding, and integrated ERP and WMS systems for quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include cold storage and industrial building owners, refrigeration equipment suppliers, construction contractors, and end-users in industries such as food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, logistics, retail, fine chemicals, precision electronics, home appliances, energy, and automotive. The company’s products are widely used in cold chain logistics facilities, industrial plants, and specialized applications like indoor ski resorts and ice-themed parks.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates in China, with a focus on economically developed coastal regions such as East China, South China, and North China. It is expanding into central and western China due to rapid growth in cold chain logistics there. The company also pursues international market expansion, particularly targeting Belt and Road Initiative countries through strategic partnerships and joint ventures.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Jingxue operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing and supplying customized insulation panels and related products for cold storage and industrial building envelope systems. It also provides integrated design, installation, and maintenance services, extending its role into downstream value-added services such as cold storage monitoring, diagnostics, energy-saving retrofits, and emergency repairs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in energy-saving and fire-retardant insulation materials, intelligent manufacturing, and green sustainable development aligned with national 'dual carbon' goals. R&D projects focus on advanced PIR foam production, integrated high-rack cold storage systems, recycling of polyurethane foam waste, photovoltaic-integrated panels, and smart cold storage doors. It holds over 100 patents and operates multiple provincial-level research centers.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized insulation sandwich panels and supporting products to cold storage and industrial building customers. The company also earns income from design, installation, and after-sales maintenance services. Sales are mostly domestic with a small but growing export component. Revenue recognition follows contract fulfillment and delivery milestones.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Jingxue is a leading domestic player in the cold storage insulation materials industry, recognized for its technological leadership, broad product coverage, and comprehensive service capabilities. It holds a top-tier market position in China’s cold storage envelope system sector, with competitive advantages in product quality, innovation, and brand reputation. The company actively participates in national and industry standards development and has received multiple national honors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.117 billion, a slight decrease of 3.01% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 29.95 million, down 21.59%. Total assets stood at RMB 1.53 billion with net assets of RMB 839 million. The company experienced some pressure on cash flow but continues to invest in R&D and production capacity. It maintains steady growth with strategic focus on market expansion and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Jingxue differentiates itself through advanced insulation technology delivering superior thermal performance, fire resistance, and durability under extreme conditions. Its patented production processes and intelligent manufacturing ensure product quality and consistency. The company offers integrated, customized envelope system solutions with full lifecycle services, enhancing customer value by reducing energy consumption and operational costs. Its strong brand and extensive project experience in cold chain and industrial sectors further reinforce its competitive edge.
